Pricing & What to Expect

In Sacramento, a single load typically costs between $99 and $199, depending on the size of the truck and the type of items. Here’s a quick breakdown:

  • Standard load (12 cu. yd.): $99‑$149 – ideal for a few pieces of furniture, a mattress, or a small pile of junk.
  • Large load (16 cu. yd.): $149‑$199 – perfect for a whole garage cleanout or multiple appliances.
  • Extra‑large or specialty items: Additional fees may apply, but the team will always give you a clear estimate first.

All pricing includes labor, fuel, and disposal fees. No extra charge for loading, unloading, or cleaning up the site.

Eco‑Friendly Commitment

Sacramento residents love the fact that 1-800-GOT-JUNK? isn’t just hauling junk to a landfill. The company partners with local charities, recycling centers, and salvage yards to divert waste from the landfill whenever possible. Some statistics to keep in mind:

  • Electronic waste is sent to certified e‑recycling facilities.

Choosing a service that prioritizes sustainability not only helps the planet but can also qualify you for local green‑business incentives.

Tips to Prepare for Your Pickup

  1. Group similar items together: Stack cardboard boxes, pile furniture, and place appliances side‑by‑side. This helps the crew load quickly.
  2. Clear pathways: Ensure there’s a clear route from the pickup point to the truck. Remove rugs, cords, or anything that could cause a trip hazard.
  3. Protect fragile pieces: If you have delicate items you still want to keep, wrap them in blankets or bubble wrap before the crew arrives.
  4. Know the rules: Certain items (like hazardous waste, tires, or large gas cylinders) are excluded. Check the FAQ section below for details.

Frequently Asked Questions

What items are NOT accepted?

Typical exclusions include asbestos, lead‑paint debris, live plants, chemicals, and large propane tanks. If you’re unsure, give the Sacramento office a quick call.

Do I need to be home during the pickup?

No. As long as a clear path exists and someone can give the crew access to the property (or you provide a lockbox code), the team can work independently.

Can I schedule recurring pickups?

Absolutely. Businesses often set up monthly or quarterly cleanouts, and the scheduling team can arrange a recurring calendar that fits your needs.

How quickly will I be charged?

Payment is collected at the end of the service. You’ll receive an itemized receipt via email for your records.
